evidence.one_abutting_building_within_15_m: 15.0 metres or less from the subject lot

calculation_handling.description: Front-yard averaging, one neighbour: where one abutting Residential-zone lot has a building fronting the same street within 15.0 m of the subject lot, the minimum front yard setback equals that building's front yard setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the neighbouring building's front yard setback and its distance from the lot.

calculation_handling.description: Front-yard averaging, two neighbours: where the lot is between two abutting Residential-zone lots, each with a building fronting the same street within 15.0 m, the minimum front yard setback is the average of those two buildings' front yard setbacks (abutting_front_setback_m read as the average of the abutting buildings).
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs both neighbouring buildings' front yard setbacks and distances.

calculation_handling.description: A building or structure must be at least 2.5 m from the original centreline of a lane.
calculation_handling.gaps: Measured from the original lane centreline, not the lot line; needs lane centreline geometry.

10.5.40.70(1).explanation: Front-yard averaging: if a neighbouring house on the same street is within 15.0 m of your lot, your front setback must match it. If there are neighbouring houses on both sides, your front setback must be the average of the two.

10.5.40.70(2).explanation: Buildings must be at least 2.5 m from the original centreline of any lane.
